description: Shows how a repository's pull request gates have fared over the last 7 and 30 days. A gate is a check the dashboard grades every pull request by (for example agent identity, persona, or "closes an issue"). For each gate: how many pull requests passed it, failed it, would have failed it (the gate only warns for now), were not checked by it, are still pending or not read yet, and were exempt (promotions, bots, or an exempt label); and the dashboard's verdict on whether the gate is ready to enforce. The gates that refused the most pull requests come first. Call it before you open or push a pull request, to see which gates usually trip pull requests here and meet them first. Counts only, no logs. Gate compliance is switched on per repository; where it is off, the answer says so. Read-only, and it never fails: if the counts cannot be read it says why.

repo.description: owner/name. Optional when the token covers one repository.

name: gate_compliance
title: Which pull request gates usually fail
